name: Kromoss (MOSS-Image-Base fine-tune)

lineage.how_derived: full fine-tune at 1024 px (update 11000 EMA weights, 704k training images); same architecture, text encoder (Qwen3.5-9B) and VAE (FLUX.2 small decoder) as MOSS-Image-SFT; two 8-step turbo LoRAs distilled from Base (DMD and DMD2) (card)

purpose: Drop-in replacement for MOSS-Image-SFT with the author's fine-tune and 8-step LoRAs (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file in the repo is the Apache License 2.0 (header opened); the base model MOSS-Image is Apache-2.0 per the moss-image-sft record.

architecture.kind: single-stream DiT (about 5.1B) as in MOSS-Image, Qwen3.5-9B text encoder, FLUX.2 VAE

variants.notes: repo total per HF API (multiple precisions); the transformer alone is about 5B parameters

pc-12gb.variant: transformer BF16 about 10 GB (5.08B x 2 bytes) plus text encoder; a quantized text encoder is needed for 16 GB cards
pc-12gb.notes: 10.2 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; part streams from RAM (dense: decode is bandwidth bound)

pc-16gb.variant: transformer BF16 about 10 GB (5.08B x 2 bytes) plus text encoder; a quantized text encoder is needed for 16 GB cards
pc-16gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (13.6 GB)

pc-24gb.variant: transformer BF16 about 10 GB (5.08B x 2 bytes) plus text encoder; a quantized text encoder is needed for 16 GB cards
pc-24gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (21.6 GB)

pc-32gb.variant: transformer BF16 about 10 GB (5.08B x 2 bytes) plus text encoder; a quantized text encoder is needed for 16 GB cards
pc-32gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (29.6 GB)

mac-16-24gb.variant: transformer BF16 about 10 GB (5.08B x 2 bytes) plus text encoder; a quantized text encoder is needed for 16 GB cards
mac-16-24gb.notes: 10.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.variant: transformer BF16 about 10 GB (5.08B x 2 bytes) plus text encoder; a quantized text encoder is needed for 16 GB cards
mac-32gb.notes: 10.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.variant: transformer BF16 about 10 GB (5.08B x 2 bytes) plus text encoder; a quantized text encoder is needed for 16 GB cards
mac-64gb+.notes: 10.2 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

strengths: 65k downloads, 351 likes in four weeks: the most visible MOSS-Image fine-tune
weaknesses: individual author, no benchmarks beyond samples and a PartiPrompts mention for the DMD2 LoRA

tona_fit.reason: Only relevant if MOSS-Image becomes an offer; then Kromoss is the community's preferred fine-tune. Unverified quality claims.
